TRIPS.n: Wales, Britannic Explorer, a Belmond Train
TRIPS.win: Valid for Departures Now Through: 23 Sep 2027
TRIPS.description: Amid quaint villages, lush valleys and kaleidoscopes of vibrant green, Wales springs to life on this 3-night journey aboard the Britannic Explorer. After sipping gin cocktails on board in the Observation Car, disembark for a series of bucolic adventures in charming Cymru. Please note: this journey departs on a Monday afternoon and concludes on a Thursday morning. Our train is subject to national railway constraints and timings are purely indicative; please check your final itinerary for confirmed timings. Due to planned engineering works on Oct 2026 and 9 Nov 2026, the train may take an alternative route.
included: LUXURY ACCOMMODATION Three nights aboard the Britannic Explorer luxury train, with 24-hour steward service.
FINE DINING Daily table d'hôte meals, including breakfasts, brunches, lunches, afternoon teas and dinners, alongside a selection of alcoholic and other beverages.
EXCITING EXCURSIONS A tailor-made itinerary of exciting and varied off-board tours and experiences.

TRIPS.n: Western Scenic Wonders, Royal Scotsman, a Belmond Train
TRIPS.win: Valid for Departures Now Through: 27 Sep 2027
TRIPS.description: For those seeking unforgettable train holidays, Scotland is sure to ignite your imagination. Take a ride on the country’s wild side on this inspiring three-night journey, exploring iconic sites. Estimated departure: 13:56 – arrival: 09:40 Our train is subject to national railway constraints and timings are purely indicative. Please check your final itinerary for confirmed timings.
included: LUXURY ACCOMMODATION Three nights aboard the Royal Scotsman luxury train, with 24-hour steward service.

TRIPS.n: Whispers at Midnight
TRIPS.win: Dates: 30 Dec 2026 - 01 Jan 2027
TRIPS.description: Celebrate New Year’s Eve with a journey aboard La Dolce Vita Orient Express, combining the charm of Rome, the gentle Tuscan hills of Bolgheri and the unique magic of Venice, before returning to Rome. An itinerary designed for those who appreciate the unhurried rhythm of travel and the pleasure of celebration, with toasts, music and memorable moments to welcome the new year with style and ease. A journey that celebrates the beauty of Italy and the emotion of a new beginning.
included: New Year’s Eve celebration, with a dinner crafted by three-Michelin-starred Chef Heinz Beck, burlesque performances, live entertainment and a DJ set carrying the evening into the night

TRIPS.n: Wild Malaysia, Eastern & Oriental Express, a Belmond Train
TRIPS.win: Valid for Departures Now Through: 28 Oct 2027
TRIPS.description: Prepare for the voyage of a lifetime, where grand history, inspiring opulence and a sense of adventure are intertwined. Journey from the urban buzz of Singapore deep into the Malaysian jungle, revelling in onboard glamour and off-board adventure all the way. Our curated excursions are rooted in cultural heritage and brought to life by local experts. Through their eyes, marvel at Taman Negara, one of the oldest tropical rainforests in the world—from there choose tiger conservation, nature photography, e-bicycle rides to ancient caves or wellness activities, and the multicultural wonders of UNESCO-listed George Town in Penang. Estimated departure: Singapore, 15:00 – arrival: Singapore, 10:20
included: COMPLIMENTARY TRANSFERS Transfer to Woodlands train station for departure. On arrival back, transfer back to your accommodation in Singapore.
LUXURY ACCOMMODATION Three nights aboard the Eastern & Oriental Express luxury train with dedicated 24-hour steward service.
FINE DINING All meals aboard the train. Also includes all house wine, house spirits and local beer. Premium drinks and drinks ordered to your cabin will be an additional charge.
TOURS & EXCURSIONS A guided tour of Taman Negara National Park, an excursion to Penang Island and a choice of cultural immersions
